name: Hyperreal wallpaper
promptTemplate: Create a macro nature image of a scene with realistic textures, shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh, in a natural outdoor setting. The image has an analog, imperfect, wabi sabi, 35mm film-like quality—grain, natural color rendering, and a soft contrast curve. Ultra-realistic detail, macro photography, 9:16 aspect ratio. Before creating the image, ask me a follow up question giving a numbered list of a few unexpected options for subject matter and then render the image.
